deterministicDispatch.note: The saved final workspace is the actual dispatch result. P3 is the stored bytes; P3e applies DSML attribute unescaping. This is deterministic dispatch recovery in an isolated copy, not a live rerun.

notes: Offline protocol recovery is not live behavioral recovery. A recovered action changes the next model input only in a live run.
The saved trace text is capped at 1000 characters. Turns at the cap are reported as truncated, not as model failures.
P0 is expected to false-positive on JSON code inside a DSML content body; that is one reason DSML must take precedence.
P4 is an ablation only. Guessing that a residual body is content is not adopted as production behavior.
